last.verdict: Raised profit outlook was offset by falling revenue, so the stock barely moved.

reasons.label: Profit guidance raised
reasons.text: Full-year adjusted EPS outlook lifted to $6.50-$6.70 from $6.00-$6.35.

reasons.label: Revenue still shrinking
reasons.text: Sales fell 3.9% to $2.8 billion; civil business revenue dropped from $827M to $702M.

reasons.label: Cash flow and debt
reasons.text: Free cash flow fell to $263M from $395M; net debt rose after acquisitions.

story: Booz Allen has repeatedly beaten profit estimates while revenue shrinks on weaker government civil spending. The stock slipped after the May report, then jumped about 10% in July on strong margins. This time the raised profit outlook met another sales decline.
